lines.text: After Samuel died and was buried in Ramah, the Philistines camped at Shunem while Saul camped at Gilboa.
The LORD gave Saul no answer, so he disguised himself and went to a medium at Hebron at night.
Saul asked the woman to bring up Samuel, and she described an old man wearing a robe.
Samuel said the LORD had given the kingdom to Jonathan, and Saul and his sons would be with him tomorrow.
The woman slaughtered a fattened calf and baked unleavened bread, and Saul and his servants ate and left that night.
